reason: An external-service integration that reads the configured DeepSeek account credential, queries the DeepSeek balance API, and presents the balance in the web interface and to agents.

summaries.zh: 通过已配置的 DeepSeek 凭据查询账户 API 余额，并在网页侧边栏及工具中提供余额查看功能。
summaries.en: Queries the configured DeepSeek account balance and makes it available in the web sidebar and through an agent tool.

capabilities: Reads the configured DEEPSEEK_API_KEY credential through the harness credentials service
Displays the account balance in a web GUI sidebar popover
Provides a deepseek_balance tool for agent balance queries
